summary.ar: العقد يحتوي على شروط عالية المخاطر تتطلب تحسينات وتعديلات فورية لحماية حقوق المنصة.
summary.en: This contract contains several high-risk clauses that need improvement to protect the platform.

clauseAnalysis.clauseText: The Service Provider shall be liable for all damages, losses, and injuries of any kind.

explanation.ar: هذا الشرط يجعلك مسؤولاً عن خسائر غير محدودة - خطر جداً وقد يؤدي لالتزامات مالية ضخمة.
explanation.en: Unlimited liability - could bankrupt you. Very dangerous.

clauseAnalysis.redlineSuggestion: The Service Provider's total liability shall be limited to 12 months of fees paid by Client.

clauseAnalysis.clauseText: Service Provider shall not work for any competitor for 5 years after contract ends.

explanation.ar: مدة 5 سنوات طويلة جداً للعاملين الحرين والمستشارين - يحد من فرص العمل المستقبلي.
explanation.en: 5 years is excessive for freelancers - limits your ability to work in the industry.

clauseAnalysis.redlineSuggestion: Service Provider shall not work with direct competitors in the same specific services for 2 years after contract ends.
